questions.text: Which organization publishes the Human Development Index (HDI), and what is a common misattribution noted in the lesson?

options.label: A
options.text: Published by the World Bank; commonly misattributed to UNDP.

options.label: B
options.text: Published by UNDP; commonly misattributed to the World Bank.

options.label: C
options.text: Published by the World Economic Forum; commonly misattributed to the IMF.

options.label: D
options.text: Published by the IMF; commonly misattributed to the World Economic Forum.

questions.solution: Correct answer: Published by UNDP; commonly misattributed to the World Bank..

questions.text: According to the lesson, what is the typical function of the final paragraph in a contemporary RC passage?

options.label: A
options.text: To introduce the central issue and define key terms

options.label: B
options.text: To present the author's personal biography and credentials

options.label: C
options.text: To offer a synthesis, recommendation, or forward-looking observation

options.label: D

questions.solution: Correct answer: To offer a synthesis, recommendation, or forward-looking observation.

questions.text: Which type of constitutional amendment would be permissible under the basic structure doctrine as described in the lesson?

options.label: A
options.text: An amendment that removes the power of judicial review

options.label: B
options.text: An amendment that expands the scope of fundamental rights

options.label: C
options.text: An amendment that alters the federal distribution of powers

options.label: D
options.text: An amendment that abolishes the basic structure doctrine itself

questions.solution: Correct answer: An amendment that expands the scope of fundamental rights.

questions.text: A state enacts a law that completely bans the sale of a certain chemical to protect public health. The government argues the ban pursues a legitimate aim and is rationally connected to that aim. However, a licensing regime with strict safety standards would achieve the same objective while imposing a lesser restriction on the right to trade. Under the four‑step proportionality test, at which step does the law fail?

options.label: A
options.text: Legitimate aim

options.label: B
options.text: Rational connection

options.label: C
options.text: Necessity

options.label: D
options.text: Proportionality stricto sensu

questions.text: In criminal law, the presumption regarding mens rea for regulatory offences is best described by which statement?

options.label: A
options.text: All regulatory offences are strict liability offences by default

options.label: B
options.text: Courts presume mens rea unless the statute expressly excludes it, especially when imprisonment is prescribed

options.label: C
options.text: Specific intent must be proved for every regulatory offence

options.label: D
options.text: General intent is sufficient to convict for any strict liability offence

questions.solution: Correct answer: Courts presume mens rea unless the statute expressly excludes it, especially when imprisonment is prescribed.

questions.text: According to the passage, which of the following best describes an implicit assumption in an argument?

options.label: A
options.text: A stated reason supporting the claim.

options.label: B
options.text: An unstated belief necessary for the argument to hold.

options.label: C
options.text: A counterargument presented for refutation.

options.label: D
options.text: A statistical evidence cited by the author.

questions.solution: Correct answer: An unstated belief necessary for the argument to hold..

questions.text: Under Hindu law, which statement accurately reflects the position on matrimonial property division on divorce?

options.label: A
options.text: The wife automatically receives half of the husband’s property upon divorce

options.label: B
options.text: There is no automatic community of property; division depends on joint ownership and judicial discretion

options.label: C
options.text: The Hindu Succession Act, 2005 grants the wife an equal share in all of the husband’s self‑acquired property

options.label: D
options.text: Section 27 of the Hindu Marriage Act allows division of all property acquired during the marriage regardless of title

questions.solution: Correct answer: There is no automatic community of property; division depends on joint ownership and judicial discretion.

questions.text: Parliament passes a constitutional amendment that removes the power of judicial review over all economic legislation, leaving only a limited appellate review. The amendment is challenged on the ground that it violates the basic structure of the Constitution. According to the basic structure doctrine as developed in Indian jurisprudence, what is the correct outcome?

options.label: A
options.text: The amendment is valid because Parliament’s plenary power under Article 368 permits any amendment.

options.label: B
options.text: The amendment is invalid because judicial review is a basic feature of the Constitution and cannot be removed even for a limited domain.

options.label: C
options.text: The amendment is valid because it only curtails judicial review in a specific policy area, not the entire power.

options.label: D
options.text: The amendment is invalid only if it also alters the identity of the Constitution’s preamble.

questions.solution: Correct answer: The amendment is invalid because judicial review is a basic feature of the Constitution and cannot be removed even for a limited domain..
